title: Repair the immutable test-defect completion contract in project scope

problem.scope_gap: The immutable repair scope allows only case-plan-request.json, while test-defect completion requires test_sha to change and currently forbids the approved successor snapshot hash.

authorized_changes: Create a project-local SpecNav Verification plugin override; do not modify the global plugin cache.
Add a signed, append-only repair-scope supersession action that preserves every existing classification, repair request, baseline, and approval artifact.
Require an explicit human-approved supersession review bound to the original failure, original repair-link digest, replacement scope digest, current Git revision, and approved successor snapshot.
Permit a test-defect repair to bind the approved successor snapshot only when case-contract check returns approved-current and test_sha changes.
Treat regenerated case snapshot and approval archive files as derived lifecycle artifacts only after their hashes and approval lineage are validated.
Add focused contract tests for scope supersession, stale approval rejection, unauthorized file rejection, immutable-history preservation, and replay idempotency.
Use the repaired project-local tool to supersede the 10 insufficient scopes, complete independent spec and quality reviews, and continue successor generation and verification.
